Description: Device Identification number, an individual number for identification.
Relative Device Address, is the Device system address, dynamically assigned by the host during initialization.
Driver Stage Register, to configure the Device's output drivers.
Device Specific Data, information about the Device operation conditions.
Operation Conditions Register. Used by a special broadcast command to identify the voltage type of the Device.
Extended Device Specific Data. Contains information about the Device capabilities and selected modes. Introduced in standard v4.0
